scope: Proposition 13.6 (Arithmetic models from a partition) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 161. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Γ, Λ be countably infinite ICC groups, with normalized scalar cocycles µ, ω, and write M = Lµ(Γ) and N = Lω(Λ). Let K be a nonzero normal bifinite M–N correspondence. Suppose that K has an orthogonal partition into nonzero finite-dimensional subspaces permuted by π(Γ) and ρ(Λ), and that Γ acts freely on its labels with finitely many orbits. Then K is a finite orthogonal sum of the models E(A, B, δ, σ) of Theorem 1.2.
